acceptanceCriteria: The installed corvint binary runs the daily change, check and seal steps as subverbs of the existing Core verb dogfood; no new root verb is added.
script/dogfood-change.sh, dogfood-check.sh and dogfood-seal.sh become thin wrappers over those subverbs and keep their make targets and environment inputs.
dogfood finish no longer executes repository scripts, reads the repository VERSION file, or builds cmd/corvint; it runs from any Git repository with only the installed binary.
A test runs change, check, seal and finish in a temporary non-Corvint repository with no script/ directory and passes.
The daily-change-evidence and local-completion specs carry numbered requirements, failure modes and rollback for the move.
body: The adopter daily path only works inside Corvint's own tree: internal/localcompletion/finish.go runs bash <root>/script/dogfood-check.sh and dogfood-change.sh, and those scripts resolve the repo from their own location, read VERSION and fall back to go build ./cmd/corvint. On any other repository (Beamfall, V1-0184; untouched repositories, V1-0019) the path cannot run. Owner decision 2026-09-24: make it portable first, ship in 0.9, then run V1-0184 with that binary.

completion.reason: Delivered by PR #160 (merge 7739f602259e41bd4ac439046a02c0bac396fcf8): the daily change/check/seal path runs from the installed binary outside Corvint's tree (DCW-V0-020..023, LCP-V0-014..015). full-gate NOT_RUN.

title: dogfood: run the daily change, check and seal path from the installed binary so it works outside Corvint's tree
